أبا نعيم محمد بن أحمد الانصاري

notes: The text is cut off after الانصاري («…وذكر مثله»): the chain stops at that name; the rest is not written and is not completed.
The opening «روى هذا الخبر» refers to the previous report by its words, not by «بإسناده»: no inherited names are taken.
